senses.gloss:
n. (-ड्यं)
1 Thickness, substance.
2 Closeness, compactness.
3 Continued sound.
E.
निविड thick, &c. ष्यञ् aff.

n. (-द्यं)
An offering of eatable articles presented to a deity, which may afterwards be distributed to his ministers or worshippers, especially when it has been presented to any form of VIṢṆU.
E.
निवेद presenting, offering, ष्यञ् aff.

n. (-कं)
A present to a Brahman who is a householder, a girl so given, or ornaments with her, &c.
E.
निवेश a house, aff. ठञ्.
